message: Asked to change the Lucky Draw top text from Gum Gum to Jelly Belly.
Updated the Lucky Draw branding text to Jelly Belly.
Asked to move the candy bag 10% to the left, show an English prompt on the right before opening, replace the prompt with the drawn candy after opening, and show a come-back-tomorrow line underneath.
Moved the bag left, created the right-side prompt/result area, and moved the drawn candy result off the bag.
Asked to make the prompt text smaller and split it into two lines.
Adjusted the Lucky Draw prompt typography.
Asked to make the prompt font smaller.
Reduced the prompt font size.
Asked to make the prompt display on one full line.
Changed the prompt to display as one line.
Said the result visuals were not suitable.
Adjusted the lucky result presentation.
Asked to remove the square background from the result, keep only the circular color fill, and remove the abbreviation letter.
Removed the square result background and abbreviation from the lucky result.
Asked to change the colorful Gallery/List and Explore More buttons to match the background style in the reference screenshot.
Updated the button styling to match the soft pill background style.
Asked to keep only Bean Number and Flavor filter features, remove color group information from the detail page, and redesign the filter layout with Search on one row and Sort By/Order on the next.
Simplified filters, removed color group from the detail view, and reorganized the search and sort controls.
Asked gallery view to show 20 flavors per page and allow users to change pages.
Added gallery pagination with 20 flavors per page.

Asked to change Try/Like/Dislike/Wish into two buttons per row for tasted/not tasted and wishlist, preferably using icons, and only show Like/Dislike on the detail page after the user marks a flavor as tasted.
Refactored collection controls into Taste/Tasted and Wish buttons, and added conditional Like/Dislike controls on detail pages.
Asked to make ingredients display like a food ingredient label as one paragraph instead of separated chips.
Converted ingredients from separate pills into one continuous paragraph.
Asked to remove bold styling and the outlined box from ingredients.
Removed the ingredients border/background and made the paragraph normal weight.
Asked to add about two lines of distance between the title and the ingredients body.
Adjusted spacing between the Flavor formula title and ingredients paragraph.
Asked to reduce the ingredients body to one line because it was too much.
Condensed the ingredients paragraph styling.

Asked to add a head bar with a Luck Draw button on the left and a profile icon button on the right linking to the final page, delete the second screenshot content, unify the last page background with the first two pages, remove Favorite Color and Tasting Mood, and make the last page rectangle one-fifth of its current size.
Created the header navigation, simplified the profile section, unified the background, and reduced the profile card footprint.
Asked to make the transition between page two and three match the transition between page one and two, make the head bar background white, and align nav content to the right with appropriate spacing.
Adjusted section transitions and changed the head bar into a white, right-aligned navigation bar.
Asked to remove Collector profile and leave only User Name plus an input.
Removed the visible Collector profile title and simplified the user name form.
Asked for the whole navigation bar to be white, make Taste/Wish buttons longer, and adjust profile/stat rectangles and font sizes so the UI/UX looks better.
Made the nav a full white bar and refined card/button sizes, heights, and typography.
Clarified that the nav bar should be similar to the reference, only with content on the right, and keep the app's current style.
Kept the app's candy style while making the nav a full-width top bar with right-aligned content.
Asked to clean unused code, verify Vite base and BrowserRouter basename for GitHub Pages, use Link instead of a tags, and ensure no inline styles, inline script tags, or layout tables.
Cleaned unused assets and CSS, confirmed base '/mp2/' and BrowserRouter basename, replaced anchors with Links, removed inline React styles, and verified no layout tables.
Shared a GitHub Pages deploy error showing a 404 deployment failure.
Explained that the code was likely correct and GitHub Pages needed to be enabled with Source set to GitHub Actions.
Asked why Actions did not rerun after making changes.
Checked the local git/workflow status, confirmed the latest run existed, and explained that changing Pages settings does not automatically rerun the workflow.
Said the navigation bar clicks did not work and did not link to each page.
Added a HashScroller component using React Router location so nav hash links scroll to Lucky Draw, Explore More, and Profile from the homepage or detail page, then verified lint and build.
